## Color profile
- Default palette constraint (only when the user did not choose a color family): no pink.
- Preferred color families: charcoal, black, gray, white, navy, blue, sage, earthy green, brown and cream.
- Accent colors: lime or orange only when justified by product identity.
- Semantic color mapping: see `COLOR_RULES.md`.
